label: NVIDIA Open (CUDA repo, open kernel modules + CUDA)
description: Official NVIDIA CUDA repo (developer.download.nvidia.com) open kernel modules with CUDA userspace. Turing+ only. Newer branches than Debian (e.g. 590/595).
notes: From NVIDIA CUDA repo. Open modules for Turing and newer. Requires headers and will fall back to Nouveau if unavailable. Subscribe to NVIDIA repo for updates.
